AI, Big data and Deep Learning all have this hype now but these are the reasons why it will fail.

  • Quality of the data sources. Selling big data is a big business, and when money is involved you have no idea if the data you just bought is real, outdated or fake.
  • Imposable to test the quality of the data. You have way too much data, and impossible to test if the data is actually good, up to date or even useful.
  • Big hard disks have data-rot. Your data is silently being corrupted when random bits suddenly flip. Testing for data corruption takes days even weeks and maybe months in the case of big data.
  • Your big data might even be wrong. Look at Windows 10, people learned to defend themselves and disabled telemetry through 3rd part applications. So the data that Microsoft collects does not represent the vast majority.
  • People will feed fake data. When people are aware that you spy on them they will alter their behavior. I for example completely use Linux to do anything on the Internet. I barely use Windows anymore.
  • Storage, saving that big data needs massive storage, which is very expensive.

Big data, AI and deep learning, that is basically selling snakes oil. You have no idea if it even works when you use it in your business. But you will convinced that it worked because you will not admit that you just bought a cat in a bag.

Okay, if you can give me two rock-solid examples of the growing relevance of deep learning outside of search engines, I'll start considering it.

Deep learning is currently being researched for employment on the battlefields of the future. Using swarm intelligence to gather millions of data points and study them using deep learning algorithms, the US soldiers of the near future will be able to predict enemy movements, weather patterns, likely positions of important targets, and much more in real time.

Secondly, the same type of deep learning is already being employed to predict health hazards, viral outbreaks, and track the spread of infections in the real world. Using deep learning software to analyze the millions of data points related to these things will help medical professionals and organizations like the CDC respond to outbreaks significantly faster than ever before.

  • "You have way too much data" That is exactly why deep learning and big data processing is important.
  • "Big hard disks have data-rot." Irrelevant. That's why we invented RAID, checksums, and other technologies that can guarantee integrity.
  • "Your big data might even be wrong." So..?
  • "People will feed fake data." Do you know what big data is..?
  • "Storage" is cheap, relatively speaking. Obviously big data only makes sense when it's economically useful.

"Two Minute Papers" by Károly Zsolnai-Fehér. It's not only about Deep Learning and AI, but a lot of his videos focus on it, because that's where a lot of exciting work is happening. There I hope you will gain an appreciation about the technology and the promise it has.
